extractorInterface.target: accepted product proof envelopes and their bound source fold, terminal seal, ZK residual, and recursive carry context material
extractorInterface.rewindingModel: public-coin transcript forking schedule over Fiat-Shamir challenge labels
acceptedInputBindings: recursive carry context root when carry mode is typed-required

componentLosses.accountingRule: one extractor failure term for the accepted source fold transcript and CE-opening outputs
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: concrete extractor over source fold proof-envelope bytes, transcript challenge labels, CE-opening responses, and public output claims

componentLosses.accountingRule: one extractor failure term for the accepted NumiSeal terminal or product seal transcript
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: concrete extractor over terminal aggregation, residual opening, lane proof, and component-root transcript bytes

componentLosses.accountingRule: one composition failure term for binding source fold extraction to the accepted product proof envelope and verifier policy
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: extractor evidence that artifact metadata, proof envelope headers, verifier policy, and product public statement roots select the same witness relation

componentLosses.accountingRule: zero at selected depth 1; one extractor failure term per typed recursive carry hop after depth promotion
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: concrete extractor for typed carry producer/consumer context bytes and parent-child replay bindings before any depth promotion

lossRule.recursivePromotionExpression: epsilon_extract(depth=d) = d * (epsilon_extract_source_fold + epsilon_extract_terminal + epsilon_extract_product) + max(d - 1, 0) * epsilon_extract_carry

hardClaimBlockers: recursive carry extractor for promoted depth
numeric extractor failure bound inside the selected total loss budget
